 In the hours leading up to Election Day, President Donald Trump hasn’t sounded confident that Republicans will defy historical trends against the president’s party in midterm elections. Listen to this article 00:00 00:00 President Donald Trump at the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool on Monday. Finn Gomez / Getty Share Add NBC News to Google Nov. 3, 2026, 5:47 PM EST By Peter Nicholas WASHINGTON — In the final sprint to the midterm elections , Donald Trump has sounded like a president bracing for losses and eager to move on to what interests him more.
